question: Which state of India does the musician Shyamamani Devi belong to?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shyamamani Devi** is a renowned musician from the state of **Odisha**, India.
 
• She is celebrated for her contributions to **Odissi music**, which is a classical music genre from Odisha.
 
• Shyamamani Devi has been honored with several awards for her exceptional talent and dedication to the field of music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Odissi music is one of the **classical music forms** of India and has a history that dates back several centuries.
 
• It is known for its **melodic and rhythmic intricacies** and is often performed during the Odissi dance.
 
• Shyamamani Devi's contributions have been instrumental in preserving and promoting this traditional art form.
